rationale: Independent source read found latest-fish rebuilding gated only by fishId inequality. Two catches with the same species but different measured size/points bypass that branch, leaving the previous catch details in the journal. The gameplay score and catch list are separately updated; this is a bounded misleading journal display, not inability to fish or a proven release-critical failure.

actual_next_action.description: Read original journal update branch and reported it before product edits; verified main agent subsequently changed the gate to catch count rather than species. Browser same-species fixture remains a further check.
